game.name: Mini Ninjas (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Mini Ninjas for Xbox 360 follows Hiro on his quest to restore harmony to a world near chaos. Use your skills and training to battle a magical army of samurai. Harness the power of your Kuji magic and use the skills of your fellow Mini Ninjas to navigate a world full of pitfalls and reach the final confrontation with the evil lord in the heart of his fortress.
